name: uberasm-princess-peach-abilities-floating-charged-jump-bomber
title: Princess Peach Abilities (Floating / Charged Jump / Bomber)
description:
This UberASM allows the player to have the skills Peach had back in SMB2, including the Peach Bomber from SSB, the SMB2 Hi-Jump (Charged Jump) and the Floating Ability from SMB2.

Originally an Asar Patch made by Ladida (Noobish Noobsicle and scepile3 are credited too), now unified, reconverted and reorganized into an unique UberASM for a better use by Black Goku... the changes were:

- Added additional customization and timers.
- Added a flag for the players in case they want to have only a player with the skills.
- Fixed the Cape bug from the Asar Patch (and the ones that triggered restricting the skills in the powerups).

Notes of the original readme made by Ladida:
- Originally, the hijump was coded by Noobish Noobsicle and i just tweaked it. but now its been coded it from scratch.
- Originally, the float was a Yoshi Flutter by scepile3and i just edited it. but now its been coded it from scratch.

Credit to me is optional.

This is my first ASM conversion, so any suggestions are welcome.

SMW Styled Peach shown here belongs to LinkstormZ.
